goal: Build a self-contained, offline SplitFair Mini App for splitting a bill. Use only local assets; do not request fonts, scripts, APIs, or other resources from external hosts. Keep allocateShares in split.mjs and add visible tests. Label the amount field exactly 'Bill total' (accessible name 'Bill total in dollars') and the people field 'Number of people'.
